snippet.title: How do I talk to my kids about gender?
snippet.description:
Alyssa McCutchan sat down with our lead pastor Bryan Mowrey to answer some of the most asked questions around the topic of gender. This video is connected to a sermon by Bryan Mowrey titled "Jesus and Gender".  You can listen to that sermon on our podcast or this YouTube channel.

Sermon Link:  https://youtu.be/tC7920sJnAY
Link to Full Q&A: https://youtu.be/sjZjN8TE--8

Additional resources mentioned by Bryan Mowrey in this video:
Embodied by Preston Sprinkle
https://www.amazon.com/Embodied-Transgender-Identities-Church-Bible/dp/0830781226

Understanding Sexual Identity by Mark Yardhouse
https://www.amazon.com/Understanding-Sexual-Identity-Resource-Ministry/dp/0310516188

Irreversible Damage by Abigail Shrier
https://www.amazon.com/Irreversible-Damage-Transgender-Seducing-Daughters/dp/1684510317
